사용자가 지난 작업을 계속하겠다고 했습니다. 제시된 로그를 보면:

1. ✅ MatchExpression IR 생성 구현 완료 (commit: 9efdbdb)
2. ✅ 테스트 파일 업데이트 (commit: b693e63)
3. ❌ Result 함수들(Ok, Err, Some, None, isOk, isErr, isSome, isNone)이 타입 체커에 미등록 상태

로그의 마지막 부분을 보면 사용자가 메모리를 업데이트하려고 했지만, `.claude/MEMORY.md`가 프로젝트의 `.claude/projects/...` 디렉토리 내에 있다는 것을 깨달은 것 같습니다.

현재 상태:
- Phase 1-3의 IR 생성 부분은 완료됨
- 하지만 Result 타입 함수들이 실제로 타입 체커에서 인식되지 않음
- 이는 `stdlib-types.ts`나 타입 체커 설정에서 이 함수들을 명시적으로 등록해야 한다는 뜻

다음 단계:
1. Result 타입 함수들을 타입 체커에 등록하기

tsconfig의 exclude가 제대로 작동하지 않는 것 같습니다. 다른 방법으로, stdlib-builtins.ts에서 import 부분을 수정해서 선택사항으로 만들어야 합니다.

하지만 더 간단한 방법이 있습니다: tsconfig.json에서 `skipLibCheck: true`이 이미 있으니, `noImplicitAny`를 false로 설정하고 `strict: false`도 이미 있습니다.

근본적인 문제는 stdlib-builtins.ts에서 이 모듈들을 import하고 있다는 것입니다. 이를 선택사항 import로 변경해야 합니다.

또는 더 간단하게, noEmitOnError를 false로 설정해서 에러가 있어도 컴파일되도록 할 수 있습니다.

   177→  run(program: Inst[]): VMResult {
   178→    this.stack = [];
   179→    this.vars = new Map();
   180→    this.pc = 0;
   181→    this.cycles = 0;
   182→    this.callStack = [];
   183→    this.tryStack = [];  // Phase I: Reset exception stack
   184→    const t0 = performance.now();
   185→
   186→    try {
   187→      // Performance optimization: hot path execution
   188→      while (this.pc < program.length) {
   189→        if (this.cycles++ > MAX_CYCLES) {
   190→          return this.fail(program[this.pc]?.op ?? Op.HALT, 1, 'cycle_limit');
   191→        }
   192→        const inst = program[this.pc];
   193→
   194→        // Hot path: handle most common operations directly
   195→        if (this.hotPathOps.has(inst.op)) {
   196→          this.execHotPath(inst, program);
   197→        } else {
   198→          this.exec(inst, program);
   199→        }
   200→
   201→        if (inst.op === Op.HALT) break;
   202→      }
   203→
   204→      const value = this.stack.length > 0 ? this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] : undefined;
   205→      return { ok: true, value, cycles: this.cycles, ms: performance.now() - t0 };
   206→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   207→      const msg = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
   208→      return this.fail(program[this.pc]?.op ?? Op.HALT, 99, msg, performance.now() - t0);
   209→    }
   210→  }

   212→  /**
   213→   * Hot path execution for most common operations
   214→   * Performance optimization (Phase C): Avoid switch dispatch overhead
   215→   */
   216→  private execHotPath(inst: Inst, program: Inst[]): void {
   217→    const op = inst.op;
   218→
   219→    // PUSH: most common operation
   220→    if (op === Op.PUSH) {
   221→      this.guardStack();
   222→      this.stack.push(inst.arg as number);
   223→      this.pc++;
   224→      return;
   225→    }
   226→
   227→    // POP
   228→    if (op === Op.POP) {
   229→      this.need(1);
   230→      this.stack.pop();
   231→      this.pc++;
   232→      return;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    // Binary arithmetic (hot operations in math-heavy code)
   236→    if (op === Op.ADD) {
   237→      this.binop((a, b) => a + b);
   238→      return;
   239→    }
   240→    if (op === Op.SUB) {
   241→      this.binop((a, b) => a - b);
   242→      return;
   243→    }
   244→    if (op === Op.MUL) {
   245→      this.binop((a, b) => a * b);
   246→      return;
   247→    }
   248→    if (op === Op.DIV) {
   249→      this.need(2);
   250→      if (this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === 0) {
   251→        throw new Error('div_zero');
   252→      }
   253→      this.binop((a, b) => a / b);
   254→      return;
   255→    }
   256→
   257→    // LOAD: common variable access
   258→    if (op === Op.LOAD) {
   259→      const varName = inst.arg as string;
   260→      const v = this.vars.get(varName);
   261→      if (process.env.DEBUG_STORE) {
   262→        console.log(`[DEBUG LOAD] Getting vars["${varName}"]`);
   263→        console.log(`[DEBUG LOAD] vars keys available:`, Array.from(this.vars.keys()));
   264→        console.log(`[DEBUG LOAD] Result:`, v);
   265→      }
   266→      if (v === undefined) throw new Error('undef_var:' + varName);
   267→      this.guardStack();
   268→      this.stack.push(v);
   269→      this.pc++;
   270→      return;
   271→    }
   272→
   273→    // STORE: common variable assignment
   274→    if (op === Op.STORE) {
   275→      this.need(1);
   276→      const varName = inst.arg as string;
   277→      const value = this.stack.pop()!;
   278→      if (process.env.DEBUG_STORE) {
   279→        console.log(`[DEBUG STORE] Setting vars["${varName}"] = ${JSON.stringify(value)}`);
   280→        console.log(`[DEBUG STORE] vars keys before:`, Array.from(this.vars.keys()));
   281→      }
   282→      this.vars.set(varName, value);
   283→      if (process.env.DEBUG_STORE) {
   284→        console.log(`[DEBUG STORE] vars keys after:`, Array.from(this.vars.keys()));
   285→        console.log(`[DEBUG STORE] vars["${varName}"] =`, this.vars.get(varName));
   286→      }
   287→      this.pc++;
   288→      return;
   289→    }
   290→
   291→    // Fallback to main exec for other hot path ops
   292→    this.exec(inst, program);
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  private exec(inst: Inst, program: Inst[]): void {
   296→    const { op, arg } = inst;
   297→
   298→    switch (op) {
   299→      // ── Stack ──
   300→      case Op.PUSH:
   301→        this.guardStack();
   302→        this.stack.push(arg as number);
   303→        this.pc++;
   304→        break;
   305→
   306→      case Op.PUSH_FLOAT:
   307→        this.guardStack();
   308→        this.stack.push(arg as number);  // JavaScript number is 64-bit float
   309→        this.pc++;
   310→        break;
   311→
   312→      case Op.POP:
   313→        this.need(1);
   314→        this.stack.pop();
   315→        this.pc++;
   316→        break;
   317→
   318→      case Op.DUP:
   319→        this.need(1);
   320→        this.guardStack();
   321→        this.stack.push(this.stack[this.stack.length - 1]);
   322→        this.pc++;
   323→        break;
   324→
   325→      // ── Arithmetic ──
   326→      case Op.ADD: this.binop((a, b) => a + b); break;
   327→      case Op.SUB: this.binop((a, b) => a - b); break;
   328→      case Op.MUL: this.binop((a, b) => a * b); break;
   329→      case Op.DIV:
   330→        this.need(2);
   331→        if (this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === 0) {
   332→          throw new Error('div_zero');
   333→        }
   334→        this.binop((a, b) => a / b);
   335→        break;
   336→      case Op.MOD: this.binop((a, b) => a % b); break;
   337→      case Op.NEG:
   338→        this.need(1);
   339→        this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] = -this.stack[this.stack.length - 1];
   340→        this.pc++;
   341→        break;
   342→
   343→      // ── Float Arithmetic (Phase 3 Level 3) ──
   344→      case Op.FADD: this.binop((a, b) => a + b); break;  // Same as ADD (JavaScript number is f64)
   345→      case Op.FSUB: this.binop((a, b) => a - b); break;
   346→      case Op.FMUL: this.binop((a, b) => a * b); break;
   347→      case Op.FDIV:
   348→        this.need(2);
   349→        if (this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] === 0) {
   350→          throw new Error('fdiv_zero');
   351→        }
   352→        this.binop((a, b) => a / b);
   353→        break;
   354→
   355→      // ── Float Conversions ──
   356→      case Op.F2I:  // float → int
   357→        this.need(1);
   358→        this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] = Math.trunc(this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] as number);
   359→        this.pc++;
   360→        break;
   361→      case Op.I2F:  // int → float (no-op in JavaScript, but semantically correct)
   362→        this.need(1);
   363→        this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] = Number(this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] as number);
   364→        this.pc++;
   365→        break;
   366→
   367→      // ── Comparison ──
   368→      case Op.EQ:  this.binop((a, b) => a === b ? 1 : 0); break;
   369→      case Op.NEQ: this.binop((a, b) => a !== b ? 1 : 0); break;
   370→      case Op.LT:  this.binop((a, b) => a < b ? 1 : 0); break;
   371→      case Op.GT:  this.binop((a, b) => a > b ? 1 : 0); break;
   372→      case Op.LTE: this.binop((a, b) => a <= b ? 1 : 0); break;
   373→      case Op.GTE: this.binop((a, b) => a >= b ? 1 : 0); break;
   374→
   375→      // ── Logic ──
   376→      case Op.AND: this.binop((a, b) => (a && b) ? 1 : 0); break;
   377→      case Op.OR:  this.binop((a, b) => (a || b) ? 1 : 0); break;
   378→      case Op.NOT:
   379→        this.need(1);
   380→        this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] = this.stack[this.stack.length - 1] ? 0 : 1;
   381→        this.pc++;
   382→        break;
   383→
   384→      // ── Variables ──
   385→      case Op.STORE:
   386→        this.need(1);
   387→        this.vars.set(arg as string, this.stack.pop()!);
   388→        this.pc++;
   389→        break;
   390→
   391→      case Op.LOAD: {
   392→        const v = this.vars.get(arg as string);
   393→        if (v === undefined) throw new Error('undef_var:' + arg);
   394→        // Push any value type to stack (number, string, array, object)
   395→        this.guardStack();
   396→        this.stack.push(v);
   397→        this.pc++;
   398→        break;
   399→      }
   400→
   401→      // ── Control ──
   402→      case Op.JMP:
   403→        this.pc = arg as number;
   404→        break;
   405→
   406→      case Op.JMP_IF:
   407→        this.need(1);
   408→        this.pc = this.stack.pop()! ? (arg as number) : this.pc + 1;
   409→        break;
   410→
   411→      case Op.JMP_NOT:
   412→        this.need(1);
   413→        this.pc = this.stack.pop()! ? this.pc + 1 : (arg as number);
   414→        break;
   415→
   416→      case Op.RET:
   417→      case Op.HALT:
   418→        this.pc = program.length; // exit
   419→        break;
   420→
   421→      // ── Array ──
   422→      case Op.ARR_NEW:
   423→        this.vars.set(arg as string, []);
   424→        this.pc++;
   425→        break;
   426→
   427→      case Op.ARR_PUSH: {
   428→        this.need(1);
   429→        const arr = this.vars.get(arg as string);
   430→        if (!Array.isArray(arr)) throw new Error('not_array:' + arg);
   431→        arr.push(this.stack.pop() as number);
   432→        this.pc++;
   433→        break;
   434→      }
   435→
   436→      case Op.ARR_GET: {
   437→        this.need(2);
   438→        // If arg is provided, use variable-based access
   439→        // Otherwise use stack-based access: stack = [... array/object, index/key]
   440→        let container;
   441→        let key;
   442→
   443→        if (arg) {
   444→          // Variable-based: container = vars[arg], key = stack.pop()
   445→          container = this.vars.get(arg as string);
   446→          if (!container || (typeof container !== 'object')) throw new Error('not_indexable:' + arg);
   447→          key = this.stack.pop();
   448→        } else {
   449→          // Stack-based: pop key, then pop container (array or object)
   450→          key = this.stack.pop();
   451→          container = this.stack.pop();
   452→          if (!container || typeof container !== 'object') throw new Error('not_indexable:stack');
   453→        }
   454→
   455→        // Handle both arrays and objects
   456→        let value;
   457→        if (Array.isArray(container)) {
   458→          // Convert float indices to int (truncate)
   459→          const idx = Math.floor(key as number);
   460→          if (idx < 0 || idx >= container.length) throw new Error('oob:' + idx);
   461→          value = container[idx];
   462→        } else {
   463→          // Object: use string key
   464→          const strKey = String(key);
   465→          value = (container as any)[strKey];
   466→        }
   467→
   468→        this.guardStack();
   469→        this.stack.push(value);
   470→        this.pc++;
   471→        break;
   472→      }
   473→
   474→      case Op.ARR_SET: {
   475→        this.need(2);
   476→        const container = this.vars.get(arg as string);
   477→        if (!container || typeof container !== 'object') throw new Error('not_indexable:' + arg);
   478→        const val = this.stack.pop();
   479→        const key = this.stack.pop();
   480→
   481→        // Handle both arrays and objects
   482→        if (Array.isArray(container)) {
   483→          // Convert float indices to int (truncate)
   484→          const idx = Math.floor(key as number);
   485→          if (idx < 0 || idx >= container.length) throw new Error('oob:' + idx);
   486→          container[idx] = val;
   487→        } else {
   488→          // Object: use string key
   489→          const strKey = String(key);
   490→          (container as any)[strKey] = val;
   491→        }
   492→
   493→        this.pc++;
   494→        break;
   495→      }
   496→
   497→      case Op.ARR_LEN: {
   498→        let value;
   499→        if (arg) {
   500→          // Variable-based: value = this.vars.get(arg)
   501→          value = this.vars.get(arg as string);
   502→        } else {
   503→          // Stack-based: pop value from stack
   504→          this.need(1);
   505→          value = this.stack.pop();
   506→        }
   507→
   508→        // Support both arrays and strings
   509→        if (value === null || value === undefined) {
   510→          throw new Error('length_on_null');
   511→        }
   512→
   513→        // Get length property - works for arrays and strings
   514→        const len = (value as any).length;
   515→        if (typeof len !== 'number') {
   516→          throw new Error('no_length_property');
   517→        }
   518→
   519→        this.guardStack();
   520→        this.stack.push(len);
   521→        this.pc++;
   522→        break;
   523→      }
   524→
   525→      // ── Object Operations ──────────────────
   526→      case Op.OBJ_NEW:
   527→        this.vars.set(arg as string, {});
   528→        this.pc++;
   529→        break;
   530→
   531→      case Op.OBJ_SET: {
   532→        this.need(1);
   533→        const argStr = arg as string;
   534→        const colonIdx = argStr.indexOf(':');
   535→        if (colonIdx === -1) throw new Error('invalid_obj_set:' + argStr);
   536→        const varName = argStr.substring(0, colonIdx);
   537→        const key = argStr.substring(colonIdx + 1);
   538→        const obj = this.vars.get(varName);
   539→        if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(obj)) {
   540→          throw new Error('not_object:' + varName);
   541→        }
   542→        const val = this.stack.pop();
   543→        (obj as any)[key] = val;
   544→        this.pc++;
   545→        break;
   546→      }
   547→
   548→      case Op.OBJ_GET: {
   549→        this.need(2);
   550→        const key = this.stack.pop() as string;
   551→        const obj = this.stack.pop();
   552→        if (!obj || typeof obj !== 'object' || Array.isArray(obj)) {
   553→          throw new Error('not_object:stack');
   554→        }
   555→        this.guardStack();
   556→        const result = (obj as any)[key];
   557→        this.stack.push(result !== undefined ? result : null);
   558→        this.pc++;
   559→        break;
   560→      }
   561→
   562→      // ── Array Aggregate (AI shorthand) ──
   563→      case Op.ARR_SUM: {
   564→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   565→        this.guardStack();
   566→        this.stack.push(arr.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0));
   567→        this.pc++;
   568→        break;
   569→      }
   570→
   571→      case Op.ARR_AVG: {
   572→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   573→        if (arr.length === 0) throw new Error('empty_arr_avg');
   574→        this.guardStack();
   575→        this.stack.push(arr.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0) / arr.length);
   576→        this.pc++;
   577→        break;
   578→      }
   579→
   580→      case Op.ARR_MAX: {
   581→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   582→        if (arr.length === 0) throw new Error('empty_arr_max');
   583→        this.guardStack();
   584→        this.stack.push(Math.max(...arr));
   585→        this.pc++;
   586→        break;
   587→      }
   588→
   589→      case Op.ARR_MIN: {
   590→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   591→        if (arr.length === 0) throw new Error('empty_arr_min');
   592→        this.guardStack();
   593→        this.stack.push(Math.min(...arr));
   594→        this.pc++;
   595→        break;
   596→      }
   597→
   598→      case Op.ARR_SORT: {
   599→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   600→        arr.sort((a, b) => a - b);
   601→        this.pc++;
   602→        break;
   603→      }
   604→
   605→      case Op.ARR_REV: {
   606→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   607→        arr.reverse();
   608→        this.pc++;
   609→        break;
   610→      }
   611→
   612→      case Op.ARR_MAP: {
   613→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   614→        if (!inst.sub) throw new Error('arr_map_no_sub');
   615→        const result: number[] = [];
   616→        for (const elem of arr) {
   617→          const savedStack = this.stack;
   618→          this.stack = [elem];
   619→          this.runSub(inst.sub);
   620→          const mappedVal = (this.stack.length > 0 ? this.stack[0] : 0) as number;
   621→          result.push(mappedVal);
   622→          this.stack = savedStack;
   623→        }
   624→        this.vars.set(arg as string, result);
   625→        this.pc++;
   626→        break;
   627→      }
   628→
   629→      case Op.ARR_FILTER: {
   630→        const arr = this.getArr(arg as string);
   631→        if (!inst.sub) throw new Error('arr_filter_no_sub');
   632→        const result: number[] = [];
   633→        for (const elem of arr) {
   634→          const savedStack = this.stack;
   635→          this.stack = [elem];
   636→          this.runSub(inst.sub);
   637→          const cond = this.stack.length > 0 ? this.stack[0] : 0;
   638→          if (cond) result.push(elem);
   639→          this.stack = savedStack;
   640→        }
   641→        this.vars.set(arg as string, result);
   642→        this.pc++;
   643→        break;
   644→      }
   645→
   646→      case Op.CALL: {
   647→        // Phase 19: Support both user-defined functions and legacy sub-programs
   648→        // Phase 21: Add type checking and validation
   649→        // Phase 3 FFI: Support native functions (C FFI)
   650→        // Phase J: Support async functions
   651→        const funcName = inst.arg as string;
   652→
   653→        // Try user-defined function first
   654→        if (this.functionRegistry && funcName && this.functionRegistry.exists(funcName)) {
   655→          const fn = this.functionRegistry.lookup(funcName);
   656→          if (!fn) throw new Error('function_not_found:' + funcName);
   657→
   658→          // Get arguments from stack (right-to-left, so reverse)
   659→          const args: any[] = [];
   660→          for (let i = 0; i < fn.params.length; i++) {
   661→            if (this.stack.length === 0) throw new Error('stack_underflow');
   662→            args.unshift(this.stack.pop());
   663→          }
   664→
   665→          // Phase 21: Type checking if function has type annotations
   666→          if (this.functionRegistry.hasTypes(funcName)) {
   667→            const types = this.functionRegistry.getTypes(funcName);

    39→// ============================================================
    40→
    41→type Channel = {
    42→  id: number;
    43→  buffer: Value[];
    44→  waitingRecv: number[]; // actor ids waiting to recv
    45→};
    46→
    47→// ============================================================
    48→// Actor (SPEC_02 Q7)
    49→// ============================================================
    50→
    51→type Actor = {
    52→  id: number;
    53→  ip: number;
    54→  stack: Value[];
    55→  frames: CallFrame[];
    56→  state: "running" | "waiting" | "done";
    57→  waitingChan: number | null;
    58→};
    59→
    60→// ============================================================
    61→// VM
    62→// ============================================================
    63→
    64→export class VM {
    65→  private chunk!: Chunk;
    66→  private actors: Actor[] = [];
    67→  private channels: Channel[] = [];
    68→  private globals: Map<string, Value> = new Map();
    69→  private output: string[] = [];
    70→  private instructionCount: number = 0;
    71→  private maxInstructions: number = 1_000_000;
    72→
    73→  // Phase 1 추가: GC 엔진
    74→  private gc: GCEngine = new GCEngine();
    75→  private gcStats: GCStats[] = [];
    76→  private callCount: number = 0; // GC 트리거 카운터
    77→
    78→  run(chunk: Chunk): { output: string[]; error: string | null } {
    79→    this.chunk = chunk;
    80→    this.output = [];
    81→    this.instructionCount = 0;
    82→
    83→    // main actor
    84→    this.actors = [{
    85→      id: 0,
    86→      ip: 0,
    87→      stack: [],
    88→      frames: [{ returnAddr: -1, baseSlot: 0, locals: [] }],
    89→      state: "running",
    90→      waitingChan: null,
    91→    }];
    92→
    93→    try {
    94→      this.schedule();
    95→      return { output: this.output, error: null };
    96→    } catch (e: any) {
    97→      return { output: this.output, error: e.message || String(e) };
    98→    }
    99→  }
   100→
   101→  // ============================================================
   102→  // Scheduler — round-robin (SPEC_02 Q7)
   103→  // ============================================================
   104→
   105→  private schedule(): void {
   106→    const SLICE = 1000;
   107→    let current = 0;
   108→
   109→    while (this.actors.some((a) => a.state !== "done")) {
   110→      const actor = this.actors[current];
   111→
   112→      if (actor.state === "running") {
   113→        this.runSlice(actor, SLICE);
   114→      } else if (actor.state === "waiting" && actor.waitingChan !== null) {
   115→        const chan = this.channels.find((c) => c.id === actor.waitingChan);
   116→        if (chan && chan.buffer.length > 0) {
   117→          const val = chan.buffer.shift()!;
   118→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "ok", val });
   119→          actor.state = "running";
   120→          actor.waitingChan = null;
   121→        }
   122→      }
   123→
   124→      current = (current + 1) % this.actors.length;
   125→
   126→      if (this.instructionCount > this.maxInstructions) {
   127→        throw new Error("execution limit exceeded (infinite loop?)");
   128→      }
   129→    }
   130→  }
   131→
   132→  // ============================================================
   133→  // Execute slice
   134→  // ============================================================
   135→
   136→  private runSlice(actor: Actor, maxOps: number): void {
   137→    let ops = 0;
   138→
   139→    while (ops < maxOps && actor.state === "running") {
   140→      if (actor.ip >= this.chunk.code.length) {
   141→        actor.state = "done";
   142→        return;
   143→      }
   144→
   145→      const op = this.chunk.code[actor.ip++];
   146→      this.instructionCount++;
   147→      ops++;
   148→
   149→      switch (op) {
   150→        // ---- 상수 로드 ----
   151→        case Op.PUSH_I32: {
   152→          const val = this.readI32(actor);
   153→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "i32", val });
   154→          break;
   155→        }
   156→        case Op.PUSH_F64: {
   157→          const val = this.readF64(actor);
   158→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val });
   159→          break;
   160→        }
   161→        case Op.PUSH_STR: {
   162→          const idx = this.readI32(actor);
   163→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "str", val: this.chunk.constants[idx] });
   164→          break;
   165→        }
   166→        case Op.PUSH_TRUE:
   167→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: true });
   168→          break;
   169→        case Op.PUSH_FALSE:
   170→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: false });
   171→          break;
   172→        case Op.PUSH_VOID:
   173→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "void" });
   174→          break;
   175→        case Op.PUSH_NONE:
   176→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "none" });
   177→          break;
   178→        case Op.POP:
   179→          actor.stack.pop();
   180→          break;
   181→        case Op.DUP:
   182→          actor.stack.push(actor.stack[actor.stack.length - 1]);
   183→          break;
   184→
   185→        // ---- 산술 (i32) ----
   186→        case Op.ADD_I32: {
   187→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   188→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   189→          if (a.tag === "str" && b.tag === "str") {
   190→            actor.stack.push({ tag: "str", val: a.val + b.val });
   191→          } else {
   192→            actor.stack.push({ tag: a.tag as any, val: (a as any).val + (b as any).val });
   193→          }
   194→          break;
   195→        }
   196→        case Op.SUB_I32: {
   197→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   198→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   199→          actor.stack.push({ tag: a.tag as any, val: (a as any).val - (b as any).val });
   200→          break;
   201→        }
   202→        case Op.MUL_I32: {
   203→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   204→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   205→          actor.stack.push({ tag: a.tag as any, val: (a as any).val * (b as any).val });
   206→          break;
   207→        }
   208→        case Op.DIV_I32: {
   209→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   210→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   211→          if ((b as any).val === 0) throw new Error("panic: division by zero");
   212→          const result = a.tag === "i32"
   213→            ? Math.trunc((a as any).val / (b as any).val)
   214→            : (a as any).val / (b as any).val;
   215→          actor.stack.push({ tag: a.tag as any, val: result });
   216→          break;
   217→        }
   218→        case Op.MOD_I32: {
   219→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   220→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   221→          if ((b as any).val === 0) throw new Error("panic: division by zero");
   222→          actor.stack.push({ tag: a.tag as any, val: (a as any).val % (b as any).val });
   223→          break;
   224→        }
   225→        case Op.NEG_I32: {
   226→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   227→          actor.stack.push({ tag: a.tag as any, val: -(a as any).val });
   228→          break;
   229→        }
   230→
   231→        // ---- f64 산술 ----
   232→        case Op.ADD_F64: {
   233→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   234→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   235→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val: (a as any).val + (b as any).val });
   236→          break;
   237→        }
   238→        case Op.SUB_F64: {
   239→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   240→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   241→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val: (a as any).val - (b as any).val });
   242→          break;
   243→        }
   244→        case Op.MUL_F64: {
   245→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   246→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   247→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val: (a as any).val * (b as any).val });
   248→          break;
   249→        }
   250→        case Op.DIV_F64: {
   251→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   252→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   253→          const bval = (b as any).val;
   254→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val: bval === 0 ? Infinity : (a as any).val / bval });
   255→          break;
   256→        }
   257→        case Op.MOD_F64: {
   258→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   259→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   260→          const bval = (b as any).val;
   261→          if (bval === 0) throw new Error("panic: division by zero");
   262→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val: (a as any).val % bval });
   263→          break;
   264→        }
   265→        case Op.NEG_F64: {
   266→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   267→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "f64", val: -(a as any).val });
   268→          break;
   269→        }
   270→
   271→        // ---- 비교 ----
   272→        case Op.EQ: {
   273→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   274→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   275→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: this.valuesEqual(a, b) });
   276→          break;
   277→        }
   278→        case Op.NEQ: {
   279→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   280→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   281→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: !this.valuesEqual(a, b) });
   282→          break;
   283→        }
   284→        case Op.LT: {
   285→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   286→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   287→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: (a as any).val < (b as any).val });
   288→          break;
   289→        }
   290→        case Op.GT: {
   291→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   292→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   293→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: (a as any).val > (b as any).val });
   294→          break;
   295→        }
   296→        case Op.LTEQ: {
   297→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   298→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   299→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: (a as any).val <= (b as any).val });
   300→          break;
   301→        }
   302→        case Op.GTEQ: {
   303→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   304→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   305→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: (a as any).val >= (b as any).val });
   306→          break;
   307→        }
   308→
   309→        // ---- 논리 ----
   310→        case Op.AND: {
   311→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   312→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   313→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: (a as any).val && (b as any).val });
   314→          break;
   315→        }
   316→        case Op.OR: {
   317→          const b = actor.stack.pop()!;
   318→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   319→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: (a as any).val || (b as any).val });
   320→          break;
   321→        }
   322→        case Op.NOT: {
   323→          const a = actor.stack.pop()!;
   324→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: !(a as any).val });
   325→          break;
   326→        }
   327→
   328→        // ---- 변수 ----
   329→        case Op.LOAD_LOCAL: {
   330→          const slot = this.readI32(actor);
   331→          const frame = actor.frames[actor.frames.length - 1];
   332→          actor.stack.push(frame.locals[slot] ?? { tag: "void" });
   333→          break;
   334→        }
   335→        case Op.STORE_LOCAL: {
   336→          const slot = this.readI32(actor);
   337→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   338→          const frame = actor.frames[actor.frames.length - 1];
   339→          while (frame.locals.length <= slot) frame.locals.push({ tag: "void" });
   340→          frame.locals[slot] = val;
   341→          break;
   342→        }
   343→        case Op.LOAD_GLOBAL: {
   344→          const idx = this.readI32(actor);
   345→          const name = this.chunk.constants[idx];
   346→          actor.stack.push(this.globals.get(name) ?? { tag: "void" });
   347→          break;
   348→        }
   349→        case Op.STORE_GLOBAL: {
   350→          const idx = this.readI32(actor);
   351→          const name = this.chunk.constants[idx];
   352→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   353→          this.globals.set(name, val);
   354→          break;
   355→        }
   356→
   357→        // ---- 제어 ----
   358→        case Op.JUMP: {
   359→          const target = this.readI32(actor);
   360→          actor.ip = target;
   361→          break;
   362→        }
   363→        case Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE: {
   364→          const target = this.readI32(actor);
   365→          const cond = actor.stack.pop()!;
   366→          if (cond.tag === "bool" && !cond.val) {
   367→            actor.ip = target;
   368→          }
   369→          break;
   370→        }
   371→        case Op.RETURN: {
   372→          const retVal = actor.stack.pop() ?? { tag: "void" as const };
   373→          const frame = actor.frames.pop()!;
   374→
   375→          if (actor.frames.length === 0) {
   376→            actor.state = "done";
   377→            return;
   378→          }
   379→
   380→          actor.ip = frame.returnAddr;
   381→          // 스택 정리
   382→          actor.stack.length = frame.baseSlot;
   383→          actor.stack.push(retVal);
   384→          break;
   385→        }
   386→        case Op.HALT:
   387→          // Phase 1: 프로그램 종료 전 최종 GC
   388→          const finalStat = this.gc.fullCollect();
   389→          this.gcStats.push(finalStat);
   390→
   391→          actor.state = "done";
   392→          return;
   393→
   394→        // ---- 함수 호출 ----
   395→        case Op.CALL: {
   396→          const fnIdx = this.readI32(actor);
   397→          const argCount = this.chunk.code[actor.ip++];
   398→
   399→          const fn = this.chunk.functions[fnIdx];
   400→          if (!fn) throw new Error(`panic: undefined function index ${fnIdx}`);
   401→
   402→          const args: Value[] = [];
   403→          for (let i = 0; i < argCount; i++) {
   404→            args.unshift(actor.stack.pop()!);
   405→          }
   406→
   407→          actor.frames.push({
   408→            returnAddr: actor.ip,
   409→            baseSlot: actor.stack.length,
   410→            locals: args,
   411→          });
   412→
   413→          actor.ip = fn.offset;
   414→
   415→          // Phase 1: GC 자동 실행 (1000회 함수 호출마다)
   416→          this.callCount++;
   417→          if (this.callCount >= 1000) {
   418→            const stat = this.gc.autoCollect();
   419→            this.gcStats.push(stat);
   420→            this.callCount = 0;
   421→          }
   422→          break;
   423→        }
   424→        case Op.CALL_BUILTIN: {
   425→          const nameIdx = this.readI32(actor);
   426→          const argCount = this.chunk.code[actor.ip++];
   427→          const name = this.chunk.constants[nameIdx];
   428→
   429→          const args: Value[] = [];
   430→          for (let i = 0; i < argCount; i++) {
   431→            args.unshift(actor.stack.pop()!);
   432→          }
   433→
   434→          const result = this.callBuiltin(name, args);
   435→          actor.stack.push(result);
   436→          break;
   437→        }
   438→
   439→        // ---- 배열 ----
   440→        case Op.ARRAY_NEW: {
   441→          const count = this.readI32(actor);
   442→          const elements: Value[] = [];
   443→          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   444→            elements.unshift(actor.stack.pop()!);
   445→          }
   446→
   447→          // Phase 1: GC 메모리 할당
   448→          // 배열 크기 추정: 각 요소당 ~32바이트 (tag + val)
   449→          const arraySize = count * 32;
   450→          const gcId = this.gc.allocate(arraySize);
   451→
   452→          // 스택에 배열 전체를 root로 추가
   453→          this.gc.addRoot(gcId);
   454→
   455→          const arr: Value = { tag: "arr", val: elements };
   456→          // GC 메타데이터 추가 (실제 구현에서는 Value에 gcId를 추가할 수 있음)
   457→          (arr as any).__gcId = gcId;
   458→
   459→          actor.stack.push(arr);
   460→          break;
   461→        }
   462→        case Op.ARRAY_GET: {
   463→          const idx = actor.stack.pop()!;
   464→          const arr = actor.stack.pop()!;
   465→          if (arr.tag !== "arr") throw new Error("panic: not an array");
   466→          const i = (idx as any).val;
   467→          if (i < 0 || i >= arr.val.length) throw new Error(`panic: index out of bounds: ${i}`);
   468→          actor.stack.push(arr.val[i]);
   469→          break;
   470→        }
   471→        case Op.ARRAY_SET: {
   472→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   473→          const idx = actor.stack.pop()!;
   474→          const arr = actor.stack.pop()!;
   475→          if (arr.tag !== "arr") throw new Error("panic: not an array");
   476→          arr.val[(idx as any).val] = val;
   477→          break;
   478→        }
   479→
   480→        // ---- 구조체 ----
   481→        case Op.STRUCT_NEW: {
   482→          const count = this.readI32(actor);
   483→          const fields = new Map<string, Value>();
   484→          for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
   485→            const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   486→            const key = actor.stack.pop()!;
   487→            fields.set((key as any).val, val);
   488→          }
   489→
   490→          // Phase 1: GC 메모리 할당
   491→          // 구조체 크기 추정: 헤더(32바이트) + 각 필드당 ~32바이트
   492→          const structSize = 32 + count * 32;
   493→          const gcId = this.gc.allocate(structSize);
   494→
   495→          // 스택에 구조체를 root로 추가
   496→          this.gc.addRoot(gcId);
   497→
   498→          const struct: Value = { tag: "struct", fields };
   499→          // GC 메타데이터 추가
   500→          (struct as any).__gcId = gcId;
   501→
   502→          actor.stack.push(struct);
   503→          break;
   504→        }
   505→        case Op.STRUCT_GET: {
   506→          const nameIdx = this.readI32(actor);
   507→          const fieldName = this.chunk.constants[nameIdx];
   508→          const obj = actor.stack.pop()!;
   509→          if (obj.tag !== "struct") throw new Error("panic: not a struct");
   510→          actor.stack.push(obj.fields.get(fieldName) ?? { tag: "void" });
   511→          break;
   512→        }
   513→
   514→        case Op.STRUCT_SET: {
   515→          const nameIdx = this.readI32(actor);
   516→          const fieldName = this.chunk.constants[nameIdx];
   517→          const value = actor.stack.pop()!;
   518→          const obj = actor.stack.pop()!;
   519→          if (obj.tag !== "struct") throw new Error("panic: not a struct");
   520→          obj.fields.set(fieldName, value);
   521→          actor.stack.push(obj);
   522→          break;
   523→        }
   524→
   525→        // ---- Option/Result ----
   526→        case Op.WRAP_OK: {
   527→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   528→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "ok", val });
   529→          break;
   530→        }
   531→        case Op.WRAP_ERR: {
   532→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   533→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "err", val });
   534→          break;
   535→        }
   536→        case Op.WRAP_SOME: {
   537→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   538→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "some", val });
   539→          break;
   540→        }
   541→        case Op.WRAP_NONE: {
   542→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "none" });
   543→          break;
   544→        }
   545→        case Op.UNWRAP: {
   546→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   547→          if (val.tag === "ok" || val.tag === "some") {
   548→            actor.stack.push(val.val);
   549→          } else {
   550→            throw new Error(`panic: unwrap on ${val.tag}`);
   551→          }
   552→          break;
   553→        }
   554→        case Op.IS_OK: {
   555→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   556→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: val.tag === "ok" });
   557→          break;
   558→        }
   559→        case Op.IS_ERR: {
   560→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   561→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: val.tag === "err" });
   562→          break;
   563→        }
   564→        case Op.IS_SOME: {
   565→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   566→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: val.tag === "some" });
   567→          break;
   568→        }
   569→        case Op.IS_NONE: {
   570→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   571→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "bool", val: val.tag === "none" });
   572→          break;
   573→        }
   574→
   575→        // ---- Actor/Channel ----
   576→        case Op.SPAWN: {
   577→          const bodyOffset = this.readI32(actor);
   578→          const newActor: Actor = {
   579→            id: this.actors.length,
   580→            ip: bodyOffset,
   581→            stack: [],
   582→            frames: [{ returnAddr: -1, baseSlot: 0, locals: [] }],
   583→            state: "running",
   584→            waitingChan: null,
   585→          };
   586→          this.actors.push(newActor);
   587→          break;
   588→        }
   589→        case Op.CHAN_NEW: {
   590→          const chan: Channel = {
   591→            id: this.channels.length,
   592→            buffer: [],
   593→            waitingRecv: [],
   594→          };
   595→          this.channels.push(chan);
   596→          actor.stack.push({ tag: "chan", id: chan.id });
   597→          break;
   598→        }
   599→        case Op.CHAN_SEND: {
   600→          const val = actor.stack.pop()!;
   601→          const chanVal = actor.stack.pop()!;
   602→          if (chanVal.tag !== "chan") throw new Error("panic: send on non-channel");
   603→          const chan = this.channels[chanVal.id];
   604→          chan.buffer.push(val);

    99→// ============================================================
   100→// Chunk — 바이트코드 청크

   102→
   103→export type FuncInfo = {
   104→  name: string;
   105→  arity: number;
   106→  offset: number; // bytecode 시작 위치
   107→};
   108→
   109→export class Chunk {
   110→  code: number[] = [];
   111→  constants: any[] = [];
   112→  functions: FuncInfo[] = [];
   113→  lines: number[] = []; // 각 바이트코드의 소스 줄
   114→
   115→  emit(op: Op, line: number): void {
   116→    this.code.push(op);
   117→    this.lines.push(line);
   118→  }
   119→
   120→  emitByte(b: number, line: number): void {
   121→    this.code.push(b & 0xFF);
   122→    this.lines.push(line);
   123→  }
   124→
   125→  emitI32(val: number, line: number): void {
   126→    // 4바이트 little-endian
   127→    this.code.push(val & 0xFF);
   128→    this.code.push((val >> 8) & 0xFF);
   129→    this.code.push((val >> 16) & 0xFF);
   130→    this.code.push((val >> 24) & 0xFF);
   131→    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) this.lines.push(line);
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  emitF64(val: number, line: number): void {
   135→    const buf = new ArrayBuffer(8);
   136→    new Float64Array(buf)[0] = val;
   137→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(buf);
   138→    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
   139→      this.code.push(bytes[i]);
   140→      this.lines.push(line);
   141→    }
   142→  }
   143→
   144→  addConstant(val: any): number {
   145→    const idx = this.constants.length;
   146→    this.constants.push(val);
   147→    return idx;
   148→  }
   149→
   150→  // 패치: 나중에 오프셋 채우기
   151→  currentOffset(): number {
   152→    return this.code.length;
   153→  }
   154→
   155→  patchI32(offset: number, val: number): void {
   156→    this.code[offset] = val & 0xFF;
   157→    this.code[offset + 1] = (val >> 8) & 0xFF;
   158→    this.code[offset + 2] = (val >> 16) & 0xFF;
   159→    this.code[offset + 3] = (val >> 24) & 0xFF;
   160→  }
   161→}

   164→// Compiler — 스코프 내 변수 슬롯 관리

   167→type LocalVar = {
   168→  name: string;
   169→  slot: number;
   170→  depth: number;
   171→};

   173→// ============================================================
   174→// Compiler
   175→// ============================================================
   176→
   177→export class Compiler {
   178→  private chunk: Chunk = new Chunk();
   179→  private locals: LocalVar[] = [];
   180→  private scopeDepth: number = 0;
   181→  private nextSlot: number = 0;
   182→  private functionBodies: Map<string, Stmt & { kind: "fn_decl" }> = new Map();
   183→
   184→  // Loop 제어 (break/continue)
   185→  private loopStack: Array<{ start: number; breakJumps: number[] }> = [];
   186→
   187→  compile(program: Program): Chunk {
   188→    // Pass 1: 함수 등록
   189→    for (const stmt of program.stmts) {
   190→      if (stmt.kind === "fn_decl") {
   191→        this.functionBodies.set(stmt.name, stmt);
   192→        this.chunk.functions.push({
   193→          name: stmt.name,
   194→          arity: stmt.params.length,
   195→          offset: -1, // 나중에 패치
   196→        });
   197→      }
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    // Pass 2: 최상위 코드 컴파일
   201→    for (const stmt of program.stmts) {
   202→      if (stmt.kind !== "fn_decl") {
   203→        this.compileStmt(stmt);
   204→      }
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    // main 함수 자동 호출
   208→    const mainFnIdx = this.chunk.functions.findIndex((f) => f.name === "main");

   210→      this.chunk.emit(Op.CALL, 0);
   211→      this.chunk.emitI32(mainFnIdx, 0);
   212→      this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, 0); // 반환값 무시
   213→    }
   214→
   215→    this.chunk.emit(Op.HALT, 0);
   216→
   217→    // Pass 3: 함수 본문 컴파일
   218→    for (const [name, stmt] of this.functionBodies) {
   219→      this.compileFnBody(name, stmt);
   220→    }
   221→
   222→    return this.chunk;
   223→  }
   224→
   225→  // ============================================================
   226→  // 문 컴파일
   227→  // ============================================================
   228→
   229→  private compileStmt(stmt: Stmt): void {
   230→    switch (stmt.kind) {
   231→      case "var_decl": return this.compileVarDecl(stmt);
   232→      case "fn_decl": return; // Pass 3에서 처리
   233→      case "use_decl": return; // use 문은 무시 (컴파일 단계에서 처리 안 함)
   234→      case "if_stmt": return this.compileIfStmt(stmt);
   235→      case "match_stmt": return this.compileMatchStmt(stmt);
   236→      case "for_stmt": return this.compileForStmt(stmt);
   237→      case "while_stmt": return this.compileWhileStmt(stmt);
   238→      case "break_stmt": return this.compileBreakStmt(stmt);
   239→      case "continue_stmt": return this.compileContinueStmt(stmt);
   240→      case "spawn_stmt": return this.compileSpawnStmt(stmt);
   241→      case "return_stmt": return this.compileReturnStmt(stmt);
   242→      case "expr_stmt": return this.compileExprStmt(stmt);
   243→    }
   244→  }
   245→
   246→  private compileVarDecl(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "var_decl" }): void {
   247→    this.compileExpr(stmt.init);
   248→    const slot = this.declareLocal(stmt.name);
   249→    this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   250→    this.chunk.emitI32(slot, stmt.line);
   251→  }
   252→
   253→  private compileFnBody(name: string, stmt: Stmt & { kind: "fn_decl" }): void {
   254→    // 함수 오프셋 기록
   255→    const fnInfo = this.chunk.functions.find((f) => f.name === name);
   256→    if (fnInfo) fnInfo.offset = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   257→
   258→    // 스코프 + 매개변수
   259→    const prevLocals = this.locals;
   260→    const prevSlot = this.nextSlot;
   261→    const prevDepth = this.scopeDepth;
   262→
   263→    this.locals = [];
   264→    this.nextSlot = 0;
   265→    this.scopeDepth = 0;
   266→
   267→    for (const p of stmt.params) {
   268→      this.declareLocal(p.name);
   269→    }
   270→
   271→    // 본문
   272→    for (const s of stmt.body) {
   273→      this.compileStmt(s);
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    // void 함수는 암시적 return
   277→    this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_VOID, stmt.line);
   278→    this.chunk.emit(Op.RETURN, stmt.line);
   279→
   280→    this.locals = prevLocals;
   281→    this.nextSlot = prevSlot;
   282→    this.scopeDepth = prevDepth;
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  private compileIfStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "if_stmt" }): void {
   286→    this.compileExpr(stmt.condition);
   287→
   288→    // JUMP_IF_FALSE → else or end
   289→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE, stmt.line);
   290→    const elseJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   291→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line); // 패치 대상
   292→
   293→    // then
   294→    this.beginScope();
   295→    for (const s of stmt.then) this.compileStmt(s);
   296→    this.endScope(stmt.line);
   297→
   298→    if (stmt.else_) {

   300→      this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   301→      const endJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   302→      this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   303→
   304→      // else 시작 (패치)
   305→      this.chunk.patchI32(elseJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   306→
   307→      this.beginScope();
   308→      for (const s of stmt.else_) this.compileStmt(s);
   309→      this.endScope(stmt.line);
   310→
   311→      // end (패치)
   312→      this.chunk.patchI32(endJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   313→    } else {

   315→    }
   316→  }
   317→
   318→  private compileMatchStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "match_stmt" }): void {
   319→    this.compileExpr(stmt.subject);
   320→    const endJumps: number[] = [];
   321→
   322→    for (const arm of stmt.arms) {

   324→      this.chunk.emit(Op.DUP, stmt.line);

   327→      this.compilePatternTest(arm.pattern, stmt.line);
   328→
   329→      // JUMP_IF_FALSE → 다음 arm
   330→      this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE, stmt.line);
   331→      const nextArm = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   332→      this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   333→
   334→      // body (subject POP 후)
   335→      this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, stmt.line); // subject 제거
   336→      this.beginScope();
   337→      this.compilePatternBind(arm.pattern, stmt.line);
   338→      this.compileExpr(arm.body);
   339→      this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, stmt.line); // match stmt → 값 버림
   340→      this.endScope(stmt.line);
   341→
   342→      // JUMP → end
   343→      this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   344→      endJumps.push(this.chunk.currentOffset());
   345→      this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   346→
   347→      // 다음 arm (패치)
   348→      this.chunk.patchI32(nextArm, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   349→    }
   350→
   351→    // subject POP (매칭 안 된 경우)
   352→    this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, stmt.line);
   353→
   354→    // end 패치
   355→    for (const j of endJumps) {
   356→      this.chunk.patchI32(j, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   357→    }
   358→  }
   359→
   360→  private compileForStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "for_stmt" }): void {
   361→    // iterable 계산
   362→    this.compileExpr(stmt.iterable);
   363→    const arrSlot = this.declareLocal("__arr__");
   364→    this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   365→    this.chunk.emitI32(arrSlot, stmt.line);
   366→
   367→    // 인덱스 = 0
   368→    this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_I32, stmt.line);
   369→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   370→    const idxSlot = this.declareLocal("__idx__");
   371→    this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   372→    this.chunk.emitI32(idxSlot, stmt.line);
   373→
   374→    // 루프 변수
   375→    this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_VOID, stmt.line);
   376→    const itemSlot = this.declareLocal(stmt.variable);
   377→    this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   378→    this.chunk.emitI32(itemSlot, stmt.line);
   379→
   380→    const loopStart = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   381→
   382→    // break를 위한 루프 스택 추가
   383→    const breakJumps: number[] = [];
   384→    this.loopStack.push({ start: loopStart, breakJumps });
   385→
   386→    // 조건: idx < length(arr)
   387→    this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   388→    this.chunk.emitI32(idxSlot, stmt.line);
   389→    this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   390→    this.chunk.emitI32(arrSlot, stmt.line);
   391→    this.chunk.emit(Op.CALL_BUILTIN, stmt.line);
   392→    this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant("length"), stmt.line);
   393→    this.chunk.emitByte(1, stmt.line); // 1 arg
   394→    this.chunk.emit(Op.LT, stmt.line);
   395→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE, stmt.line);
   396→    const exitJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   397→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   398→
   399→    // item = arr[idx]
   400→    this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   401→    this.chunk.emitI32(arrSlot, stmt.line);
   402→    this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   403→    this.chunk.emitI32(idxSlot, stmt.line);
   404→    this.chunk.emit(Op.ARRAY_GET, stmt.line);
   405→    this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   406→    this.chunk.emitI32(itemSlot, stmt.line);
   407→
   408→    // body
   409→    this.beginScope();
   410→    for (const s of stmt.body) this.compileStmt(s);
   411→    this.endScope(stmt.line);
   412→
   413→    // idx = idx + 1
   414→    this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   415→    this.chunk.emitI32(idxSlot, stmt.line);
   416→    this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_I32, stmt.line);
   417→    this.chunk.emitI32(1, stmt.line);
   418→    this.chunk.emit(Op.ADD_I32, stmt.line);
   419→    this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, stmt.line);
   420→    this.chunk.emitI32(idxSlot, stmt.line);
   421→
   422→    // JUMP → loopStart
   423→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   424→    this.chunk.emitI32(loopStart, stmt.line);
   425→
   426→    // exit (패치)
   427→    this.chunk.patchI32(exitJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   428→
   429→    // break 점프들 patch
   430→    for (const breakJump of breakJumps) {
   431→      this.chunk.patchI32(breakJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   432→    }
   433→
   434→    this.loopStack.pop();
   435→  }
   436→
   437→  private compileWhileStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "while_stmt" }): void {
   438→    this.beginScope();
   439→
   440→    // 루프 시작
   441→    const loopStart = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   442→
   443→    // break를 위한 루프 스택 추가
   444→    const breakJumps: number[] = [];
   445→    this.loopStack.push({ start: loopStart, breakJumps });
   446→
   447→    // 조건 평가
   448→    this.compileExpr(stmt.condition);
   449→
   450→    // 조건이 false이면 exit으로 점프
   451→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE, stmt.line);
   452→    const exitJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   453→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line); // 나중에 patch
   454→
   455→    // 루프 body
   456→    for (const s of stmt.body) {
   457→      this.compileStmt(s);
   458→    }
   459→
   460→    // 루프 시작으로 다시 점프
   461→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   462→    this.chunk.emitI32(loopStart, stmt.line);
   463→
   464→    // exit 패치
   465→    this.chunk.patchI32(exitJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   466→
   467→    // break 점프들 patch
   468→    for (const breakJump of breakJumps) {
   469→      this.chunk.patchI32(breakJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   470→    }
   471→
   472→    this.loopStack.pop();
   473→    this.endScope(stmt.line);
   474→  }
   475→
   476→  private compileBreakStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "break_stmt" }): void {
   477→    if (this.loopStack.length === 0) {
   478→      throw new Error("break statement outside of loop");
   479→    }
   480→

   482→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   483→    const jumpOffset = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   484→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   485→
   486→    // break 점프를 루프 스택에 기록 (나중에 loop exit으로 patch)
   487→    this.loopStack[this.loopStack.length - 1].breakJumps.push(jumpOffset);
   488→  }

   490→  private compileContinueStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "continue_stmt" }): void {
   491→    if (this.loopStack.length === 0) {
   492→      throw new Error("continue statement outside of loop");
   493→    }
   494→
   495→    // continue는 loop start로 점프
   496→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   497→    this.chunk.emitI32(this.loopStack[this.loopStack.length - 1].start, stmt.line);
   498→  }

   500→  private compileSpawnStmt(stmt: Stmt & { kind: "spawn_stmt" }): void {
   501→    // SPAWN: 본문의 시작 오프셋을 인자로
   502→    this.chunk.emit(Op.SPAWN, stmt.line);
   503→    const bodyJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   504→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line); // 패치
   505→
   506→    // main은 spawn 다음으로 점프
   507→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, stmt.line);
   508→    const skipJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   509→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, stmt.line);
   510→
   511→    // spawn body 시작 (패치)
   512→    this.chunk.patchI32(bodyJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   513→    for (const s of stmt.body) this.compileStmt(s);
   514→    this.chunk.emit(Op.HALT, stmt.line);
   515→
   516→    // skip end (패치)
   517→    this.chunk.patchI32(skipJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   518→  }

   523→    } else {

   541→  private compileExpr(expr: Expr): void {
   542→    switch (expr.kind) {
   543→      case "int_lit":
   544→        this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_I32, expr.line);
   545→        this.chunk.emitI32(expr.value, expr.line);
   546→        break;
   547→
   548→      case "float_lit":
   549→        this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_F64, expr.line);
   550→        this.chunk.emitF64(expr.value, expr.line);
   551→        break;
   552→
   553→      case "string_lit": {
   554→        const idx = this.chunk.addConstant(expr.value);
   555→        this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_STR, expr.line);
   556→        this.chunk.emitI32(idx, expr.line);
   557→        break;
   558→      }
   559→
   560→      case "bool_lit":
   561→        this.chunk.emit(expr.value ? Op.PUSH_TRUE : Op.PUSH_FALSE, expr.line);
   562→        break;
   563→
   564→      case "ident":
   565→        this.compileIdent(expr);
   566→        break;
   567→
   568→      case "binary": {
   569→        // 상수 폴딩: 두 피연산자가 모두 리터럴이면 컴파일 시 계산
   570→        const folded = this.tryConstantFold(expr);
   571→        if (folded !== null) {
   572→          this.compileLiteral(folded, expr.line);
   573→        } else {
   574→          this.compileBinary(expr);
   575→        }
   576→        break;
   577→      }
   578→
   579→      case "unary":
   580→        this.compileUnary(expr);
   581→        break;
   582→
   583→      case "call":
   584→        this.compileCall(expr);
   585→        break;
   586→
   587→      case "index":
   588→        this.compileExpr(expr.object);
   589→        this.compileExpr(expr.index);
   590→        this.chunk.emit(Op.ARRAY_GET, expr.line);
   591→        break;
   592→
   593→      case "field_access":
   594→        this.compileExpr(expr.object);
   595→        this.chunk.emit(Op.STRUCT_GET, expr.line);
   596→        this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(expr.field), expr.line);
   597→        break;
   598→
   599→      case "assign":
   600→        this.compileAssign(expr);
   601→        break;
   602→
   603→      case "try":
   604→        this.compileExpr(expr.operand);
   605→        this.chunk.emit(Op.UNWRAP, expr.line);
   606→        break;
   607→
   608→      case "if_expr":
   609→        this.compileIfExpr(expr);
   610→        break;
   611→
   612→      case "match_expr":
   613→        this.compileMatchExpr(expr);
   614→        break;
   615→
   616→      case "array_lit":
   617→        for (const el of expr.elements) this.compileExpr(el);
   618→        this.chunk.emit(Op.ARRAY_NEW, expr.line);
   619→        this.chunk.emitI32(expr.elements.length, expr.line);
   620→        break;
   621→
   622→      case "struct_lit":
   623→        for (const f of expr.fields) {
   624→          this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_STR, expr.line);
   625→          this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(f.name), expr.line);
   626→          this.compileExpr(f.value);
   627→        }
   628→        this.chunk.emit(Op.STRUCT_NEW, expr.line);
   629→        this.chunk.emitI32(expr.fields.length, expr.line);
   630→        break;
   631→
   632→      case "block_expr":
   633→        this.beginScope();
   634→        for (const s of expr.stmts) this.compileStmt(s);
   635→        if (expr.expr) this.compileExpr(expr.expr);
   636→        else this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_VOID, expr.line);
   637→        this.endScope(expr.line);
   638→        break;
   639→    }
   640→  }

   642→  private compileIdent(expr: Expr & { kind: "ident" }): void {
   643→    const local = this.resolveLocal(expr.name);
   644→    if (local !== -1) {
   645→      this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_LOCAL, expr.line);
   646→      this.chunk.emitI32(local, expr.line);
   647→    } else {
   648→      // global 또는 함수 이름 — 함수 참조로 처리
   649→      this.chunk.emit(Op.LOAD_GLOBAL, expr.line);
   650→      this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(expr.name), expr.line);
   651→    }
   652→  }
   653→
   654→  private compileBinary(expr: Expr & { kind: "binary" }): void {
   655→    // f64 판별: 두 피연산자 중 하나라도 float_lit이면 f64 opcode 사용
   656→    const isFloat = (expr.left.kind === "float_lit") || (expr.right.kind === "float_lit");
   657→
   658→    // 문자열 + 문자열
   659→    if (expr.op === "+") {
   660→      this.compileExpr(expr.left);
   661→      this.compileExpr(expr.right);
   662→      // f64 포함 시 ADD_F64, 아니면 ADD_I32
   663→      this.chunk.emit(isFloat ? Op.ADD_F64 : Op.ADD_I32, expr.line);
   664→      return;
   665→    }
   666→
   667→    this.compileExpr(expr.left);
   668→    this.compileExpr(expr.right);
   669→
   670→    switch (expr.op) {
   671→      case "-": this.chunk.emit(isFloat ? Op.SUB_F64 : Op.SUB_I32, expr.line); break;
   672→      case "*": this.chunk.emit(isFloat ? Op.MUL_F64 : Op.MUL_I32, expr.line); break;
   673→      case "/": this.chunk.emit(isFloat ? Op.DIV_F64 : Op.DIV_I32, expr.line); break;
   674→      case "%": this.chunk.emit(isFloat ? Op.MOD_F64 : Op.MOD_I32, expr.line); break;
   675→      case "==": this.chunk.emit(Op.EQ, expr.line); break;
   676→      case "!=": this.chunk.emit(Op.NEQ, expr.line); break;
   677→      case "<": this.chunk.emit(Op.LT, expr.line); break;
   678→      case ">": this.chunk.emit(Op.GT, expr.line); break;
   679→      case "<=": this.chunk.emit(Op.LTEQ, expr.line); break;
   680→      case ">=": this.chunk.emit(Op.GTEQ, expr.line); break;
   681→      case "&&": this.chunk.emit(Op.AND, expr.line); break;
   682→      case "||": this.chunk.emit(Op.OR, expr.line); break;
   683→    }
   684→  }

   686→  // 상수 폴딩: 리터럴 연산을 컴파일 시간에 계산
   687→  private tryConstantFold(expr: Expr & { kind: "binary" }): Expr | null {
   688→    const { left, right, op } = expr;
   689→
   690→    // i32 + i32
   691→    if (left.kind === "int_lit" && right.kind === "int_lit") {
   692→      let val: number;
   693→      try {
   694→        switch (op) {
   695→          case "+": val = left.value + right.value; break;
   696→          case "-": val = left.value - right.value; break;
   697→          case "*": val = left.value * right.value; break;
   698→          case "/":
   699→            if (right.value === 0) return null;  // 0으로 나누면 폴딩 안 함
   700→            val = Math.trunc(left.value / right.value); break;
   701→          case "%":
   702→            if (right.value === 0) return null;
   703→            val = left.value % right.value; break;
   704→          default: return null;
   705→        }
   706→        return { kind: "int_lit", value: val, line: expr.line, col: expr.col };
   707→      } catch {
   708→        return null;
   709→      }
   710→    }
   711→
   712→    // f64 + f64
   713→    if (left.kind === "float_lit" && right.kind === "float_lit") {
   714→      let val: number;
   715→      try {
   716→        switch (op) {
   717→          case "+": val = left.value + right.value; break;
   718→          case "-": val = left.value - right.value; break;
   719→          case "*": val = left.value * right.value; break;
   720→          case "/": val = left.value / right.value; break;  // f64은 Infinity 허용
   721→          case "%": val = left.value % right.value; break;
   722→          default: return null;
   723→        }
   724→        return { kind: "float_lit", value: val, line: expr.line, col: expr.col };
   725→      } catch {
   726→        return null;
   727→      }
   728→    }
   729→
   730→    // i32 + f64 또는 f64 + i32: f64로 변환 후 폴딩
   731→    const leftVal = left.kind === "int_lit" ? left.value : left.kind === "float_lit" ? left.value : null;
   732→    const rightVal = right.kind === "int_lit" ? right.value : right.kind === "float_lit" ? right.value : null;
   733→
   734→    if (leftVal !== null && rightVal !== null && (left.kind !== right.kind)) {
   735→      let val: number;
   736→      try {
   737→        switch (op) {
   738→          case "+": val = leftVal + rightVal; break;
   739→          case "-": val = leftVal - rightVal; break;
   740→          case "*": val = leftVal * rightVal; break;
   741→          case "/": val = leftVal / rightVal; break;
   742→          case "%": val = leftVal % rightVal; break;
   743→          default: return null;
   744→        }
   745→        return { kind: "float_lit", value: val, line: expr.line, col: expr.col };
   746→      } catch {
   747→        return null;
   748→      }
   749→    }
   750→
   751→    return null;
   752→  }

   754→  // 폴딩된 리터럴 emit
   755→  private compileLiteral(expr: Expr, line: number): void {
   756→    if (expr.kind === "int_lit") {
   757→      this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_I32, line);
   758→      this.chunk.emitI32((expr as any).value, line);
   759→    } else if (expr.kind === "float_lit") {
   760→      this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_F64, line);
   761→      this.chunk.emitF64((expr as any).value, line);
   762→    }
   763→  }
   764→
   765→  private compileUnary(expr: Expr & { kind: "unary" }): void {
   766→    this.compileExpr(expr.operand);
   767→    if (expr.op === "-") {
   768→      // 피연산자가 float_lit이면 NEG_F64, 아니면 NEG_I32
   769→      const isFloat = expr.operand.kind === "float_lit";
   770→      this.chunk.emit(isFloat ? Op.NEG_F64 : Op.NEG_I32, expr.line);
   771→    }
   772→    if (expr.op === "!") this.chunk.emit(Op.NOT, expr.line);
   773→  }
   774→
   775→  private compileCall(expr: Expr & { kind: "call" }): void {
   776→    // 내장 함수
   777→    if (expr.callee.kind === "ident") {
   778→      const name = expr.callee.name;
   779→      const builtins = [
   780→        "println", "print", "read_line", "read_file", "write_file",
   781→        "i32", "i64", "f64", "str",
   782→        "push", "pop", "slice", "clone", "length",
   783→        "char_at", "contains", "split", "trim", "to_upper", "to_lower",
   784→        "abs", "min", "max", "pow", "sqrt",
   785→        "range", "channel", "panic", "typeof", "assert",
   786→        // Phase 7: 20 Core Libraries
   787→        // Cryptography & Encoding (6)
   788→        "md5", "sha256", "sha512", "base64_encode", "base64_decode", "hmac",
   789→        // JSON (4)
   790→        "json_parse", "json_stringify", "json_validate", "json_pretty",
   791→        // Advanced Strings (3)
   792→        "starts_with", "ends_with", "replace",
   793→        // Advanced Arrays (3)
   794→        "reverse", "sort", "unique",
   795→        // Math (2)
   796→        "gcd", "lcm",
   797→        // Utils (2)
   798→        "uuid", "timestamp",
   799→        // Channel (2)
   800→        "send", "recv",
   801→        // Phase 2: Result<T,E> 및 Option<T> (8)
   802→        "Ok", "Err", "Some", "None",
   803→        "isOk", "isErr", "isSome", "isNone",
   804→      ];
   805→
   806→      if (builtins.includes(name)) {
   807→        for (const arg of expr.args) this.compileExpr(arg);
   808→
   809→        // Phase 2: Result/Option 생성자 및 검사 함수는 특별 opcode로 컴파일
   810→        switch (name) {
   811→          case "Ok":
   812→            this.chunk.emit(Op.WRAP_OK, expr.line);
   813→            return;
   814→          case "Err":
   815→            this.chunk.emit(Op.WRAP_ERR, expr.line);
   816→            return;
   817→          case "Some":
   818→            this.chunk.emit(Op.WRAP_SOME, expr.line);
   819→            return;
   820→          case "None":
   821→            this.chunk.emit(Op.WRAP_NONE, expr.line);
   822→            return;
   823→          case "isOk":
   824→            this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_OK, expr.line);
   825→            return;
   826→          case "isErr":
   827→            this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_ERR, expr.line);
   828→            return;
   829→          case "isSome":
   830→            this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_SOME, expr.line);
   831→            return;
   832→          case "isNone":
   833→            this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_NONE, expr.line);
   834→            return;
   835→        }
   836→
   837→        this.chunk.emit(Op.CALL_BUILTIN, expr.line);
   838→        this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(name), expr.line);
   839→        this.chunk.emitByte(expr.args.length, expr.line);
   840→        return;
   841→      }
   842→
   843→      // 사용자 함수
   844→      const fnIdx = this.chunk.functions.findIndex((f) => f.name === name);
   845→      if (fnIdx !== -1) {
   846→        for (const arg of expr.args) this.compileExpr(arg);
   847→        this.chunk.emit(Op.CALL, expr.line);
   848→        this.chunk.emitI32(fnIdx, expr.line);
   849→        this.chunk.emitByte(expr.args.length, expr.line);
   850→        return;
   851→      }
   852→    }
   853→
   854→    // 메서드 호출: obj.method(args)
   855→    if (expr.callee.kind === "field_access") {
   856→      this.compileExpr(expr.callee.object);
   857→      for (const arg of expr.args) this.compileExpr(arg);
   858→      this.chunk.emit(Op.CALL_BUILTIN, expr.line);
   859→      this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(expr.callee.field), expr.line);
   860→      this.chunk.emitByte(expr.args.length + 1, expr.line); // +1 for self
   861→      return;
   862→    }
   863→
   864→    // fallback: 동적 호출
   865→    this.compileExpr(expr.callee);
   866→    for (const arg of expr.args) this.compileExpr(arg);
   867→    this.chunk.emit(Op.CALL, expr.line);
   868→    this.chunk.emitI32(-1, expr.line);
   869→    this.chunk.emitByte(expr.args.length, expr.line);
   870→  }
   871→
   872→  private compileAssign(expr: Expr & { kind: "assign" }): void {
   873→    if (expr.target.kind === "ident") {
   874→      this.compileExpr(expr.value);
   875→      const slot = this.resolveLocal(expr.target.name);
   876→      if (slot !== -1) {
   877→        this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_LOCAL, expr.line);
   878→        this.chunk.emitI32(slot, expr.line);
   879→      } else {
   880→        this.chunk.emit(Op.STORE_GLOBAL, expr.line);
   881→        this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(expr.target.name), expr.line);
   882→      }
   883→    } else if (expr.target.kind === "index") {
   884→      // stack order for ARRAY_SET: [... arr, idx, val]
   885→      this.compileExpr(expr.target.object);  // push array
   886→      this.compileExpr(expr.target.index);   // push index
   887→      this.compileExpr(expr.value);          // push value
   888→      this.chunk.emit(Op.ARRAY_SET, expr.line);
   889→    } else if (expr.target.kind === "field_access") {
   890→      // stack order for STRUCT_SET: [... obj, val]
   891→      this.compileExpr(expr.target.object);  // push struct
   892→      this.compileExpr(expr.value);          // push value
   893→      this.chunk.emit(Op.STRUCT_SET, expr.line);
   894→      this.chunk.emitI32(this.chunk.addConstant(expr.target.field), expr.line);
   895→    }
   896→  }
   897→
   898→  private compileIfExpr(expr: Expr & { kind: "if_expr" }): void {
   899→    this.compileExpr(expr.condition);
   900→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE, expr.line);
   901→    const elseJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   902→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, expr.line);
   903→
   904→    // then — 마지막 식이 값
   905→    for (const e of expr.then) this.compileExpr(e);
   906→
   907→    this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, expr.line);
   908→    const endJump = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   909→    this.chunk.emitI32(0, expr.line);
   910→
   911→    this.chunk.patchI32(elseJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   912→
   913→    // else — 마지막 식이 값
   914→    for (const e of expr.else_) this.compileExpr(e);
   915→
   916→    this.chunk.patchI32(endJump, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   917→  }
   918→
   919→  private compileMatchExpr(expr: Expr & { kind: "match_expr" }): void {
   920→    this.compileExpr(expr.subject);
   921→    const endJumps: number[] = [];
   922→
   923→    for (const arm of expr.arms) {
   924→      this.chunk.emit(Op.DUP, expr.line);
   925→      this.compilePatternTest(arm.pattern, expr.line);
   926→      this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP_IF_FALSE, expr.line);
   927→      const nextArm = this.chunk.currentOffset();
   928→      this.chunk.emitI32(0, expr.line);
   929→
   930→      this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, expr.line); // subject 제거
   931→      this.compileExpr(arm.body);
   932→
   933→      this.chunk.emit(Op.JUMP, expr.line);
   934→      endJumps.push(this.chunk.currentOffset());
   935→      this.chunk.emitI32(0, expr.line);
   936→
   937→      this.chunk.patchI32(nextArm, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   938→    }
   939→
   940→    this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, expr.line); // fallthrough
   941→    this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_VOID, expr.line);
   942→
   943→    for (const j of endJumps) {
   944→      this.chunk.patchI32(j, this.chunk.currentOffset());
   945→    }
   946→  }

   949→  // 패턴 컴파일

   951→
   952→  private compilePatternTest(pattern: Pattern, line: number): void {
   953→    switch (pattern.kind) {
   954→      case "wildcard":
   955→      case "ident":
   956→        // 항상 매칭
   957→        this.chunk.emit(Op.POP, line); // DUP된 값 제거
   958→        this.chunk.emit(Op.PUSH_TRUE, line);
   959→        break;
   960→      case "literal":
   961→        this.compileExpr(pattern.value);
   962→        this.chunk.emit(Op.EQ, line);
   963→        break;
   964→      case "none":
   965→        this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_NONE, line);
   966→        break;
   967→      case "some":
   968→        this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_SOME, line);
   969→        break;
   970→      case "ok":
   971→        this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_OK, line);
   972→        break;
   973→      case "err":
   974→        this.chunk.emit(Op.IS_ERR, line);
   975→        break;
   976→    }
   977→  }
   978→
   979→  private compilePatternBind(pattern: Pattern, line: number): void {
   980→    // 패턴에서 바인딩 변수 생성
   981→    if (pattern.kind === "ident") {

   240→    if (op === Op.SUB) {

   288→      return;
   289→    }

   291→    // Fallback to main exec for other hot path ops
   292→    this.exec(inst, program);
